info.name: HelpCore API
info.description:
Internal IT support ticketing API built with Django REST Framework.  
Employees submit tickets, which are automatically routed to the correct  
IT staff member based on category. Role-based access ensures Employees,  
IT Staff, and Admins each see only what's relevant to them.

Auth: Basic Auth (temporary — will be replaced with JWT).

item.name: Categories
item.description: Manage ticket categories. Viewable by all authenticated users; create/edit/delete restricted to Admins.
